name: One Song by Miet Warlop
description: Commissioned by NTGent as part of their Histoire(s) du Théâtre series, Miet Warlop's 'One Song' examines the fundamental question: what is the history of theatre? Warlop delivers an exuberant, sensory-rich performance exploring how humans connect through life, grief, and mortality. This work represents cutting-edge European performance art addressing the nature of theatrical practice itself.
